Thank you for taking the time to write this, and sorry for the automated reply.

**This repository does not accept external code contributions**, so this pull
request is being closed unreviewed. That is not a judgement on your change.
We keep the copyright in the codebase undivided on purpose, because that lets
us state where the software came from without qualification. Merging outside
code would end that permanently, and it cannot be undone one contribution at a
time.

**What is welcome, and what we read:**

- **Bug reports and feature requests.** Please open an issue that describes
  the problem or the need. A description of the problem is what we can act on,
  and it is the part we actually want.
- **Security vulnerabilities.** Please do *not* use a public issue. Report them
  through the Security tab, or by email as described in
  [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/DoCoNEXT/doconext-nc-ui/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

You remain free to fork this package and modify it for your own purposes under
the AGPL.
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/DoCoNEXT/doconext-nc-ui/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
explains the reasoning in full.
